description.zh-Hans: 超超超短篇文字小游戏♪ 在这里，你将扮演一名在一家（神秘？）医院临时工作的志愿者，在温馨的日常中，探索这里的（恐怖真相？）温暖故事！这里，你的选择可能会引领你到三个结局, 欢迎大家前来探索~
description.en: An ultra-ultra-short text mini-game♪ Here, you will play as a volunteer temporarily working at a (mysterious?) hospital, exploring the (horrifying truth?) warm stories here in the cozy daily life! Here, your choices may lead you to three endings. Welcome everyone to explore~
